mapper.insert: insert into corgi_fake_user_pool (`user_id`) select f.follow_user_id from corgi_user_follow f join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = f.follow_user_id and f.type = 'real' join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = f.follow_user_id where p.uptime < #{time} and d.avatar_status is null and avatar_check_status = 'normal' group by f.follow_user_id order by count(1) limit #{size}
mapper.select: select d.user_id userId, l.tel_no telNo, d.nickname, d.avatar, d.`height`, d.`weight`, d.`role`, d.`group`, d.`birthday`, d.`con`, p.`city`, p.province hideGroup, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, if(p.fuptime > 0, p.fuptime, p.uptime) `time` from corgi_user_follow f join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = f.follow_user_id and f.type = 'real' join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = f.follow_user_id join corgi_user_login l on l.id = f.follow_user_id where p.uptime < #{time} and d.avatar_status is null and avatar_check_status != 'check' group by f.follow_user_id having count(1) >= 5 order by p.uptime
mapper.insert: insert ignore into corgi_user_follow (`user_id`, `follow_user_id`, `uptime`, `type`) values ( #{userId}, #{followId}, NOW(), 'fake' );
